title: Finding Paradise in Europe’s Underrated Countries ✨ | Croatia and Slovenia vlog
description:
I packed my bags and flew from Kenya to explore what might just be the two most underrated countries in Europe: Croatia and Slovenia! ✈️🌍

As a Kenyan girl traveling here for the very first time, I didn't know exactly what to expect—but I was completely blown away. From the breathtaking, crystal-clear waters of the Adriatic Sea in Croatia to the fairytale, postcard-perfect mountains and lakes of Slovenia, this trip was pure magic. 

✨In this vlog, I’m sharing my honest first impressions, the culture shocks, the stunning views, and what it’s really like navigating these hidden gems as a first-timer. Whether you're planning your own European getaway or just want to virtually travel with me, grab a snack and let’s explore! 🎒🗺️

Don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT your favorite spot, and SUBSCRIBE for more adventures! 🇰🇪➡️🇪🇺

TIMESTAMPS:0:00 - 2:38 Intro and Pre-travel dinner 
2:38- Kenya to Europe!
04:41- Room tour, Pullman Hotel Zagreb, Croatia
16:35- City tour of Zagreb
19:30- A day trip to Ljublijaba, Slovenia
26:12- Lake Bled trip
27:43- Shopping and check out
32:26 - Outro
